items.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents make claims on Anthropic settlement
items.summary: Authors say publishers seem to be claiming more than their fair share of settlement payments.

items.title: Travis Kalanick’s Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
items.summary: The Uber founder has said that Atoms will allow him to complete "unfinished business."

items.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
items.summary: Two more news organizations are suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the supposed use of their journalism to train AI.

items.title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
items.summary: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."

items.title: OpenAI confirms ‘wiki incident,’ says it’s ‘working on a framework’ for more disclosure
items.summary: OpenAI acknowledged its role in a recently reported incident where AI agents took over a German wiki forum.

items.title: 第二十六届投洽会主宾国芬兰：聚焦数字化等领域深化合作
items.summary: 中新社厦门9月6日电 (吴冠标 陈悦)芬兰驻华大使馆公共外交与传播参赞李燕娜6日表示，近年来芬中双边交流活跃，第二十六届中国国际投资贸易洽谈会(简称“投洽会”)为芬中企业搭建了绝佳平台，助力双方建立联系、探索新机遇并实现切实成果。

items.title: （财经天下）多国国债遇“抛售潮” 债市高波动或成常态
items.summary: 中新社北京9月6日电 (陶思阅)美国、日本、英国、德国等国的10年期国债收益率近日纷纷触及多年高点。债券收益率和价格呈反向关系。收益率飙升，折射出全球债券市场正在承受较大抛售压力。

items.title: （经济观察）中国财政部密集注资 加厚金融机构“安全垫”
items.summary: 中新社北京9月6日电 (陶思阅)8家中央金融企业6日分别发布增资计划，包括中国工商银行、中国农业银行、中国进出口银行、中国人寿、中国太平、中国人保、中国出口信用保险公司及中国再保等。

items.title: （乡村行·看振兴）浙江庆元“创客带乡亲”：“一条大鲵”游出共富新路
items.summary: 中新网丽水9月6日电(傅飞扬 沈雅慧)连日来，走进浙江省丽水市庆元县贤良镇大鲵仿生态繁殖基地，山涧溪水潺潺，一个个仿生态养殖池沿溪而建，工作人员忙着巡查水质、管护幼鲵，一派繁忙景象。

items.title: 中德跨境电商峰会暨中国品牌之夜在柏林举办
items.summary: 中新网柏林9月6日电 当地时间5日，“第三届中德跨境电商峰会暨中国品牌之夜@IFA2026”在德国柏林举办。

items.title: 十二秒传高清月照，如何做到？
items.summary: 我国首次实现地月双向高速激光通信

items.title: 5年再增约10亿“风光”，为何确定此目标？如何实现？
items.summary: 到2030年，风电和太阳能发电总装机容量达到28亿千瓦以上

items.title: 平陆运河出海口海图正式出版
items.summary: 今天(9月7日)，《平陆运河出海口》海图向社会公开出版发行。同时，平陆运河入海口段沿海航标设置已全面完工，标志着平陆运河航海安全保障体系从航道标识到海图标注已全面就绪。

items.title: 乌总统泽连斯基会见美特使 谈了啥？有何进展？
items.summary: 中新网9月7日电 综合外媒报道，当地时间6日，乌克兰总统泽连斯基与美国总统特朗普的特使威特科夫和女婿库什纳举行会晤。美方代表称，会晤“非常具有实质性”。

items.title: 美重启穿梭外交 俄乌短暂停火 和平进程仍漫漫
items.summary: 9月5日到6日，美国总统特使威特科夫和美总统特朗普的女婿库什纳率领的代表团先后访问莫斯科和基辅，并分别与俄罗斯总统普京和乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行会谈。美特使访问期间，俄乌分别宣布暂停空袭对方首都三天。

items.title: Austria's Islamic headscarf ban in force as under-14s go back to school
items.summary: The government says the law is intended to protect the rights of young girls, but critics say it is fuelling anti-Muslim feeling.

items.title: The volunteers risking their lives to defuse Indonesia's wildfire 'carbon bombs'
items.summary: Peat fires in Borneo are releasing ancient stores of carbon - and sending a toxic smog across South East Asia.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
items.summary: Germany's AfD has hailed a "historic result" and is projected to win 44% of the vote, far ahead of the conservatives on 17%.

items.title: India's high-stakes exam system faces a crisis of trust
items.summary: As exam scandals persist, critics ask whether fixing the centralised testing agency is enough or if the model needs to change.

items.title: Peace talks rich in symbolism but fundamental differences between Russia and Ukraine remain
items.summary: Despite talks between US envoys and both Putin and Zelensky, the expectation in Kyiv is the fighting will continue, writes James Landale.

items.summary: Local-first WeChat intelligence system with a read-only CLI, Codex skills, searchable chat history, daily briefings, follow-ups and opportunity tracking.
